from datetime import date

import pytest

from planner.exams import Exam, find_exam_clashes, load_exams
from planner.model import PlannerError


def test_load_exams_valid_and_strips_fields(tmp_path):
    path = tmp_path / "exams.csv"
    path.write_text(
        "course, date, start, end\n CS101 , 2025-12-10 , 09:05 , 10:00 \n",
        encoding="utf-8",
    )
    assert load_exams(path) == [Exam("CS101", date(2025, 12, 10), 545, 600)]


@pytest.mark.parametrize("contents, message", [
    ("", "empty CSV"),
    ("course,date,start\n", "missing required column"),
    ("course,course,date,start,end\n", "duplicate"),
    ("course,date,start,end\n,2025-12-10,09:00,10:00\n", "course must not be empty"),
    ("course,date,start,end\nCS,2025-2-10,09:00,10:00\n", "invalid date"),
    ("course,date,start,end\nCS,2025-02-30,09:00,10:00\n", "invalid date"),
    ("course,date,start,end\nCS,2025-12-10,9:00,10:00\n", "invalid start time"),
    ("course,date,start,end\nCS,2025-12-10,09:00,24:00\n", "invalid end time"),
    ("course,date,start,end\nCS,2025-12-10,10:00,10:00\n", "end time must be later"),
    ("course,date,start,end\nCS,2025-12-10,09:00\n", "too few"),
    ("course,date,start,end\nCS,2025-12-10,09:00,10:00,extra\n", "too many"),
    ("course,date,start,end\nCS,\"bad,09:00,10:00\n", "invalid CSV"),
])
def test_rejects_malformed_exam_csv(tmp_path, contents, message):
    path = tmp_path / "bad.csv"
    path.write_text(contents, encoding="utf-8")
    with pytest.raises(PlannerError, match=message):
        load_exams(path)


def test_rejects_binary_and_missing_files(tmp_path):
    binary = tmp_path / "binary.csv"
    binary.write_bytes(b"course,date,start,end\n\xff\xfe\n")
    with pytest.raises(PlannerError, match="invalid text encoding"):
        load_exams(binary)
    with pytest.raises(PlannerError, match="cannot read exams file"):
        load_exams(tmp_path / "missing.csv")


def test_header_without_data_is_rejected(tmp_path):
    path = tmp_path / "empty.csv"
    path.write_text("course,date,start,end\n", encoding="utf-8")
    with pytest.raises(PlannerError, match="no data rows"):
        load_exams(path)


def test_find_exam_clashes_only_selected_courses_and_half_open():
    day = date(2025, 12, 10)
    exams = [
        Exam("A", day, 9 * 60, 10 * 60),
        Exam("B", day, 10 * 60, 11 * 60),  # touching is not a clash
        Exam("C", day, 9 * 60 + 30, 10 * 60 + 30),
        Exam("A", day, 9 * 60 + 15, 9 * 60 + 45),  # same course, ignored
        Exam("D", date(2025, 12, 11), 9 * 60, 10 * 60),
    ]
    assert find_exam_clashes(exams, ["A", "B", "C", "D"]) == [
        (exams[0], exams[2]),
        (exams[1], exams[2]),
    ]
    assert find_exam_clashes(exams, ["A", "B"]) == []
    assert find_exam_clashes(exams, []) == []
    with pytest.raises(PlannerError, match="unknown course.*X"):
        find_exam_clashes(exams, ["X"])


def test_find_exam_clashes_preserves_input_order_and_deduplicates_courses():
    day = date(2025, 12, 10)
    a = Exam("A", day, 9 * 60, 10 * 60)
    b = Exam("B", day, 9 * 60, 10 * 60)
    assert find_exam_clashes([a, b], ["A", "A", "B"]) == [(a, b)]

"""Generate a large but satisfiable timetable for the M2 benchmark.

Forty courses with five sections each, every section a one-hour class on one
day. To make the instance realistically hard yet definitely solvable, a hidden
"master plan" is drawn first: each course gets its own day and hour, so the
sections that follow the master plan never clash with each other. The other
four sections are random noise, which creates plenty of partial clashes.

Usage: ``python tests/make_bench.py`` writes ``tests/data/bench_40x5.csv``.
"""

import csv
import random
from pathlib import Path

COURSES = 40
SECTIONS_PER_COURSE = 5
DAYS = ("Mon", "Tue", "Wed", "Thu", "Fri")
# Non-adjacent one-hour slots: 08:00-09:00, 10:00-11:00, ... 18:00-19:00.
HOURS = range(8, 19, 2)
LOCATIONS = ("Hall A", "Science Center", "Engineering Hall", "Math Hall", "Library")
DEFAULT_PATH = Path(__file__).with_name("data") / "bench_40x5.csv"


def generate(seed: int = 20240) -> list[tuple[str, str, str, str, str, str]]:
    """Return ``(course, section, day, start, end, location)`` rows."""
    rng = random.Random(seed)
    plan: list[tuple[str, int]] = []
    # Distinct (day, hour) pairs keep the master plan clash-free.
    cells = [(day, hour) for day in DAYS for hour in HOURS]
    rng.shuffle(cells)
    if COURSES > len(cells):
        raise ValueError("not enough distinct slots for a clash-free master plan")
    plan = cells[:COURSES]

    rows = []
    for index, (day, hour) in enumerate(plan):
        course = f"C{index:02d}"
        slots = [(day, hour)]
        while len(slots) < SECTIONS_PER_COURSE:
            candidate = (rng.choice(DAYS), rng.choice(list(HOURS)))
            if candidate not in slots:
                slots.append(candidate)
        for section, (slot_day, slot_hour) in enumerate(slots):
            rows.append(
                (
                    course,
                    f"S{section}",
                    slot_day,
                    f"{slot_hour:02d}:00",
                    f"{slot_hour + 1:02d}:00",
                    rng.choice(LOCATIONS),
                )
            )
    return rows


def write(path: Path = DEFAULT_PATH, seed: int = 20240) -> Path:
    rows = generate(seed)
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    with path.open("w", newline="", encoding="utf-8") as handle:
        writer = csv.writer(handle)
        writer.writerow(("course", "section", "day", "start", "end", "location"))
        writer.writerows(rows)
    return path


if __name__ == "__main__":
    print(write())

def cmd_plan(args: argparse.Namespace) -> int:
    sections = _load(args.file)
    courses = list(dict.fromkeys(args.courses))
    order = preferences.normalise_order(args.prefer)
    if len(courses) == 1:
        # A single course has nothing to rank; show its first usable section.
        schedules = solve(sections, courses, limit=1)
        choices = schedules[0]
        print("schedule:")
        _print_schedule(choices)
        print(render([row for choice in choices for row in choice.meetings]), end="")
        return 0
    result = ranking.search(
        sections,
        courses,
        order=order,
        not_before=_minutes(args.not_before),
        limit=args.top,
    )
    if not result.best:
        raise PlannerError("no schedule without overlaps is possible")
    how_many = len(result.best)
    if result.complete:
        print(f"{result.total} feasible schedule(s) found; best {how_many}:")
    else:
        print(
            f"search stopped after {result.explored} steps; showing the best"
            f" {how_many} of at least {result.total} feasible schedule(s):"
        )
    for item in result.best:
        _print_ranked(item, result.total, result.complete)
    return 0
